source_of_truth: Chapters 12, 13, 14 and 15 of KneeSchool_Master_Operations_Handbook.pdf, under the authority order confirmed by decision 009.
base_url_note: Chapter 1 of the Master Operations Handbook names the platform KneeSchool.com. The canonical link is built from this value, so if the live domain differs this is the one line to change.

seo.note: Chapter 14 requires an SEO title, a meta description, a slug, an H1, an H2 structure, related articles, internal links and image alt text on every page. The bounds are the ordinary search engine display limits; the handbook does not state numbers.

medical_safety.required_sentence: It does not give individual medical advice and it does not replace assessment by a clinician
medical_safety.source: Chapter 12, Medical Safety: patient-facing pages must explain that information is educational and not a substitute for professional assessment.
medical_safety.applies_to: every page, not only the patient facing ones, because a reader arrives at a professional page as easily as a patient one
